reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model P1711-P, which is not on the recalled model list (P1410, P1410-P, P1411, P1411-P). Under the claim policy, a legible label showing a non-recalled model means the unit is not part of the recall, so the claim is denied. The typed model matches this reading (mismatch).
The purchase date 2006-01-03 is before the program's sale window (2006-10-01 to 2021-12-31). Purchases before the window are denied.
No duplicate claims were found, and the retailer is on the list, so these do not change the outcome; the denial rests on the model mismatch and the pre-window purchase date.
